quote: There's a woman who walks the Lake Michigan shoreline every morning at 4 AM. She's been doing it since before I was born. My grandmother remembers her. Same age. Same coat. The coat hasn't faded.
source: Lakefront patrol report, annotated by hand
context: Persistent figures in the GLMZ are documented informally but never investigated. The woman has been reported by three generations of shoreline patrols. She has never been approached.
